book.name: 2 Bhasesalonike
book.title: Baluwa ja kabhele jaka Paulo kwa Bhasesalonike

content: Mtulobhilaye kwaka Chapanga
Ujomukelu, bhalongu, mtulobhilaje nahuli kubha ubholu waka Bambo upetalyaje kujaghanila manyata na kujopalewa kwa utopelu ngati bhela moubheli pachilanda jinu.
Ndobhaje kabhete nahuli Chapanga atukengalyaje na bhandu bhahakau na bhana mahoku, maghambu nga bhokapi bhabhuhobhalela ubholu hoghu.
Nambu Bambo nde ndongwana, najombi anaampekya ukangamalu mwehapa na kundenda wichu na Muhakau Jola.
Na jombi Bambo atupekeha lihobhalelu likolongwa panani jinu, na ngachetubhi na choghohi kubha mtenda na ananjendalya kutenda ghala ghatukumpwaghile.
Bambo ajilonguhaje mitima jinu mu umanyi ukolongwa wa upalu waka Chapanga na mu uhinakalilu ghotupekewa na Kristo.
Lilakalilu kubhokana na ukata
Bhalongu, tundaghalakila mu Lihina laka Bambo Yesu Kristo, mulijepaje na bhalongu bhokapi bhabhabhi bhakata na ambabhu ngachebhajengalela malaghalakilu ghatukumpekihi mwenga.
Maghambu mwehapa mabheni mmanyi ntundu moipalakila kujengalela ulenganesu witu. Tepani ngachetukabhi vakata patukabhi papamu na mwehapa,
wala ngachetukalili chilebhi chaka mundu jokapi panga na kulepa. Tukahengiki lihengu kwa ukangamalu na mang'ahiku na ikilu na muhi nahuli ngatwikubha chibwahila kwaka mundu jokapi pachilanda jinu.
Tukatendiki anana, nga kwa ndandi ngachetupalika kupata ujangatilu winu, nambu kwa ndandi tupala kumpekeha ulenganesu.
Patukabhi papamu na mwehapa, tukampekihi amuli: “Mundu jokapi jwangakupala kuhenga lihengu, ngayikula chilbhi.”
Kwa kubha tujowana kubha bhakumu bha bhandu pachilanda jinu nde bhakata. Ngachebhahenga mahengu ghabhu bheni, nambu bhalijingiha mu mambu gha bhandu bhangi.
Henu bhandu ngati bhanihabha tundaghalakila na kundakalila mu lihina laka Bambo Yesu Kristo bhahengaje lihengu kwa kulilongoha bheni na kulipatila ghaghapalika mu matamu ghabhu bhene.
Nambu mwehapa bhalongu, ngamwitonda kutenda ghambone!
Ngati mundu jokapi ngacheghatii malaghalakilu ghitu ghaghabhi mu baluwa jenjenu, mulilingalya namaa na mundu hoju. Wala ngamwijangatana naku, nahuli kubha apata kubhona ihoni.
Nambu ngamwambalanga kubha adui, nambu mundakalyaje ngati ndongo.
Ulamukilu wa kujomulela
Henu, Bambo wa lukwali mweni ampekye lukwali chikahi chokapi na kwa kila indela. Bambo akubha na mwehapa mabhokapi.
Nepani Paulo, nundembela ulamukilu ghoni kwa chiwoku changu namwete. Jeniheji nde alama jangu mu baluwa yangu yokapi, kubha anana nde monembela.
Chihomu chaka Bambo witu Yesu Kristo chibya papamu na mwehapa mabhokapi. Amina.
